text:
The season that comes after autumn is winter.

To help understand the encryption concept described in the text, consider the analogy of a public library book drop box. Anyone can see the box and drop a sealed envelope into it (the encrypted message), ensuring that no one else can read the contents while it is in transit. However, only the librarian with the specific key to the internal sorting room (the recipient with the key) can open the box, retrieve the envelope, and read the message. This illustrates how encryption maintains confidentiality: the data is visible and transportable by anyone, but its meaning remains protected until accessed by the authorized party.
